scientific_limitations: Initial nonnegativity refers to the origin only; no assumption of global Wigner positivity.
Single bosonic mode, finite Fock cutoff, vacuum-environment pure loss; the objective is output origin value, not integrated Wigner negativity.
Finite checks support but do not prove the universal theorem; equivalence with inaccessible related literature remains possible.
title: Sharp photon-cutoff staircase for loss-induced Wigner parity inversion
